name: browserhive-monorepo
description: BrowserHive monorepo root. The published artifact is packages/browserhive.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @browserhive/contracts build && bun run --filter @browserhive/core build && bun run --filter @browserhive/dashboard build && bun run --filter browserhive build
scripts.test: bun run test:server && bun run test:dashboard
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run depcruise && bun run test && bun run gen:openapi --check && bun run gen:docs --check && bun run gen:db-types --check
scripts.ci:local: bun run check && bun run build && bun run test:integration && bun run package:check
scripts.release:version: changeset version && bun run sync:version && bun run gen:openapi && bun install --lockfile-only
scripts.release:publish: bun run build && bun run package:check && changeset publish
scripts.test:server: bun test packages/contracts packages/core/src packages/core/test/persistence packages/core/test/lint packages/browserhive/src packages/browserhive/test/cli packages/browserhive/test/composition test/lint test/docs
